theme: Protect income. Care for home. Build our way forward.
northStar: Keep the next few days obvious, the next couple of weeks easy to scan, and the longer direction available without making it dominate daily life.
workNorthStar: Protect dependable income while replacing lower-leverage hours with better work and repeatable 3DVR revenue, without letting the business consume home and family life.
operatingRule: Today first. Then the next few days. Protect recovery and home time before filling open space with more work.
workOperatingRule: Protect booked income, use open blocks for the highest-leverage work, and keep home/family commitments visible as real commitments.

today.title: Personal block + evening work
today.sharedDetail: The morning is the useful open block. Protect the afternoon personal appointment, then the evening is booked for work.
today.detail: Use one focused morning block for the highest-priority revenue or admin work, then protect the personal block and booked evening shift.

nextDays.title: Open day
nextDays.sharedDetail: Best flexible day before the weekend run. Use one focused block for money/work, prep for the Mexico-house window, and keep meaningful time available for home/family.
nextDays.detail: Revenue/client follow-up first, then Mexico-house prep and one bounded portal reliability task.

nextDays.title: Work day
nextDays.sharedDetail: Early work day ending mid-afternoon. Keep the rest of the day relatively light before Saturday work and the Mexico-house block.
nextDays.detail: Protect booked income; avoid filling the afternoon with low-leverage work.

nextDays.title: Morning work
nextDays.sharedDetail: Work in the morning, then transition toward home/family time and getting ready for the Mexico-house block.
nextDays.detail: Protect the morning shift, then keep business work minimal and prepare for the protected home block.

next30.title: Use the open day deliberately
next30.label: Sep 17
next30.sharedDetail: Thursday is the main flexible day before two work days and the Mexico-house block. Use it deliberately without turning it into another full shift.
next30.detail: Use one focused revenue/follow-up block, prepare for the house window, and stop before the day disappears into low-leverage work.

next30.title: Create breathing room
next30.label: Late Sep → early Oct
next30.sharedDetail: After the dense work run, the calendar is mostly open until a booked work day on Oct 1. Use the lighter stretch deliberately instead of automatically filling every day.
next30.detail: Balance family/home time with better-work hunting, active paid work, and a bounded 3DVR reliability push.

next30.title: Make income less fragile
next30.label: By mid-Oct
next30.sharedDetail: Keep dependable work while building at least one more repeatable source of income.
next30.detail: Pursue another paying client or recurring opportunity and higher-value freelance work.

next90.title: More control over the schedule
next90.label: October
next90.sharedDetail: Create fewer chaotic weeks and more choice over which work Thomas says yes to.
next90.detail: Replace weaker work selectively while keeping the financial floor intact.

next90.title: More predictable independent income
next90.label: November–December
next90.sharedDetail: Shift some income toward recurring work so every month does not start from zero.
next90.detail: Scale the service/channel that actually produces legitimate revenue with low support burden.

milestones.label: rest/family time protected in a normal week when possible
additional paying client or repeat engagement
fewer surprises and less reconstructing plans from messages
